notes: Reached via Chrome directly, no WAF/bypass needed. robots.txt (masonhome.in/robots.txt) is a standard Shopify-agent-aware file naming ClaudeBot nowhere with a site-wide disallow -- fully open (Allow: / for User-agent: *). Site is a Shopify store; used same-origin fetch() from the loaded page (javascript_tool) against /collections.json (paginated, 201 total collections retrieved) as the sitemap-equivalent full category enumeration, then keyword-filtered for furniture terms and verified every candidate individually. The site's mega-menu 'Furniture' nav item (handle furniture-lighting, page title 'Furniture') is a combined marketing/API bucket whose own collection page lists 42 products; enumerating its /products.json and taking the UNION of its 6 real sub-collections (coffee-center-tables 4 + side-tables-1 15 + c-tables 0 + drinks-table 5 + pouffes-and-ottomans 12 + barcarts-trolleys 6 = 42 unique product handles) exactly matches the 42-product set of furniture-lighting itself (0 items in either set only), proving full coverage with no double-count and no missed child. 'Side Tables & C Tables' is the nav-level combined 'VIEW ALL' listing over the Side Tables and C Tables children (site's own labelled 'VIEW ALL' link, excluded as a category per brief S3) -- recorded only as a grouping row, its two real children recorded as leaves. C Tables (/collections/c-tables) is a live nav-linked node currently at 0 products: rendered page shows 'No products' empty-state text and /products.json enumeration returns 0 entries -- emitted as a normal leaf per brief S7b#4, not omitted. Every qty was corroborated by comparing the rendered 'N products' header text against an independent /collections/<handle>/products.json enumeration count; all matched exactly (no OTTO-style padding, no Muuto-style colourway inflation observed). Separately found 'Accent Tables' (/collections/accent-tables): a LIVE (HTTP 200) but currently orphaned collection not linked from the visible Furniture mega-menu and not part of the furniture-lighting union above; it holds exactly 1 real product ('Franklin Short Table', product_type SIDE TABLES, tags /accenttables /sidetable per its product JSON) that is not present in any other furniture collection. Included as a genuine furniture leaf but flagged for manual review since it is not currently promoted in primary site navigation. Checked and confirmed EMPTY (0 products, stale/unused Shopify auto-collections not linked anywhere in current nav) and excluded: artesia-tables, nesting-tables, nordic-speckled-tables, table-fable, desk-organisers, olvera-desk-planter, doha-velvet-pouffes, shoe-racks, umbrella-stands, luggage-rack, modena-luggage-racks. Also checked and excluded as non-furniture or duplicate: oxford-tables-1 (1 product, duplicate of a product already counted in side-tables-1/furniture-lighting), melrose-stand (8 products, all 'Hand Towel Stand'/'Agate Hand Towel Stand' -- bathroom accessory stands, not furniture), Bedding/Bedsheets/Cotton Bedspreads/Velvet Bedspreads (textile), Table Mats/Table Napkins & Rings/Table Runners (textile, out of scope here per prior Kitchen&Dining pass), Cake Stands/Coasters/Serving Trays (kitchen & dining decor, prior pass scope), Desk Organisers/Olvera Desk Planter (decor accessories, empty anyway), Clothes Drying Rack (household utility, not furniture), Vanity Mirrors (mirror/wall decor, and 0 products besides). No sofas, beds, wardrobes, dressers, cabinets, desks (as furniture, not organisers), bookcases, dining tables/chairs, or office furniture collections exist anywhere in the store's 201-collection catalogue -- confirmed by exhaustive keyword scan (furnitur/sofa/chair/table/bed/desk/cabinet/wardrobe/stool/bench/dresser/shelv/bookcase/seating/nightstand/armchair/ottoman/console/sideboard/recliner/daybed/chaise/loveseat/vanity/stand/pouf/rack/rocker/settee/trolley/trunk) across the full paginated /collections.json export. Mason Home's live furniture assortment is genuinely small: accent/side/coffee/drinks/C-tables, ottomans & poufs, and bar carts & trolleys only.
